title: Claude plans and pricing (November 2026): Free, Pro, Max and Ultra compared
desc: Claude Pro is $20 a month ($17 billed annually), Max is $100 and Ultra is $200. What each plan includes, Max vs Ultra, and what changed on Oct 31, 2026.
dek: Short answer: Free costs nothing, Pro is $20 a month (or $17 a month billed annually, $200 up front), Max is $100 a month and Ultra is $200 a month. Ultra replaced the old $200 Max 20x plan in late October 2026. It has no 5-hour limit for verified accounts and 10x Pro's weekly usage.

body.p: Anthropic's pricing page lists four plans for individuals, as of our November 1, 2026 check. Prices "don’t include applicable tax" and "are subject to change at Anthropic's discretion," so check the [official pricing page](https://www.anthropic.com/pricing) before you pay.

ul: **Price:** free ("Free for everyone").
**Usage:** "Limited usage every 5 hours and every week."
**Includes:** chat on web, desktop and mobile; search the web, create files and run code; memory across conversations; connecting your apps and tools; Artifacts; and Claude Design, Slides and Docs.
**Projects:** up to 5.
**Price:** $20 a month if billed monthly, or $17 a month "with annual subscription discount" ($200 billed up front).
**Usage:** "More usage than Free, every 5 hours and every week." The FAQ says Pro gives "at least 5x more usage per 5-hour session than Free."
**Includes:** everything in Free, plus handing off and scheduling tasks, Claude Dashboards (beta), Claude Code, Claude Science, Projects, "More Claude models" and Claude in Chrome and Microsoft 365.
**Fable:** "paid with usage credits." Usage credits let you "keep working at standard API rates," so using Fable on Pro costs extra.
**Price:** $100 a month, billed monthly.
**Usage:** "5x Pro usage every 5 hours and every week."

**Includes:** everything in Pro, plus "Fable included, up to half your weekly limit," "$100 a month in API credits to build on the Claude Platform," early access to advanced Claude features and priority access at high traffic times.
**Price:** $200 a month, billed monthly.
**Usage:** "No 5-hour limit" and "10x Pro usage every week." The no-5-hour-limit perk is "for verified accounts."
**Includes:** everything in Max, plus "$200 a month in API credits, up from $100 on Max." Fable is included for up to 50% of weekly limits, the same as Max.

body.p: On every plan, "How fast you reach a limit depends on the model you use, how long your chats are, and how large your files are"; there's "no fixed message count," and chat and Claude Code draw "from the same pool." Check yours in **Settings > Usage**.
The pricing page changed between our October 30 and October 31, 2026 checks. The page itself gives no date for the switch.

ul: **Before:** one Max plan "From $100" where you could "Choose 5x or 20x more usage than Pro," listed as Max 5x and Max 20x. The FAQ measured this "per 5-hour session," and the card listed "$100 to $200/month in API credits."

**After:** Max is a single $100 plan with 5x Pro usage. The $200 tier is now Ultra, with 10x Pro's weekly usage and no 5-hour limit for verified accounts. "Higher output limits for all tasks" is gone from the Max card.
**New model:** Fable, which the FAQ calls "our top model," was added: paid with usage credits on Pro, up to half your weekly limit on Max and Ultra.
**API credits** are now fixed: $100 a month on Max, $200 on Ultra.
**Unchanged:** Pro is still $20 a month, or $17 a month billed annually.

body.p: The page doesn't say what happens to existing Max 20x subscribers. The old 20x was measured per 5-hour session and the new 10x is per week, so the page doesn't say whether heavy users get more or less in total.

body.h: Max vs Ultra: which is it?

body.p: Both include everything in Pro and Fable for up to half your weekly limit, and both are billed monthly. The differences:

ul: **Max ($100)** gives 5x Pro's usage, and that applies both every 5 hours and every week.
**Ultra ($200)** gives 10x Pro's weekly usage and removes the 5-hour limit for verified accounts. It's pitched "For your longest tasks": long sessions that would run into a 5-hour cap.
**API credits:** $100 a month on Max, $200 on Ultra.

body.p: If you were on Max 20x, compare your numbers in Settings > Usage before your next renewal, and make sure your account is verified.

ul: **Team** is "For teams of 2 to 150." A Standard seat is $20 per seat a month billed annually, or $25 billed monthly, with "more usage than Pro." A Premium seat is $100 per seat a month billed annually, or $125 billed monthly, with "5x more usage than standard seats." Teams get "Up to $500 per month in pooled API credits."

**Enterprise** is "US$20/seat/month, billed annually, 20 seat minimum," plus usage "billed at API rates." The 20-seat minimum, added in October 2026, means at least $4,800 a year in seat fees before any usage.

body.p: Team and Enterprise list "No model training on your content by default." On Free, Pro, Max and Ultra, model training is listed as "Opt-out."

ol: **Change plans** under **Settings > Billing**, then Manage subscription. Upgrades "take effect right away" and unused time is credited. Downgrades "take effect at the end of your current billing period."

**Cancel** on the web or desktop app under **Settings > Billing**, then Cancel. If you subscribed through the App Store or Google Play, cancel there. Cancel "at least 24 hours before your renewal date" to avoid the next charge.
**After cancelling,** your plan stays active until the period ends, then moves to Free. Your chats, projects and files stay with your account.

body.p: Payments are "generally non-refundable," with some exceptions. For refunds and team billing, see the FAQ on the [official pricing page](https://www.anthropic.com/pricing).

sources: Anthropic: Claude pricing (our snapshots, October 30 to November 1, 2026)
QuietlyChanged: Claude's $200 plan becomes "Ultra": no 5-hour limit, but 10x Pro's weekly usage instead of 20x per session (Oct 31, 2026)
QuietlyChanged: Claude Enterprise now lists a 20-seat minimum (Oct 15, 2026)
